title: Jacob Q1: Costa Rica vs London right now

turns.prompt: What's the time difference between Costa Rica and London right now?

judge.criteria: Baseline: 'London is 7 hours ahead of you right now … The UK clocks go back tonight … so from tomorrow the difference drops to 6 hours.' Pass marks: speaks to the user ('ahead of you'), gives the difference for this moment, notes a clock change if one is within a day. No handle, no generic rule only.
